allowed_response_claims: The pinned workflow computed all eight requested vis, amp, cphase, and logcamp diagnostics for the two bands and two observed FITS execution families.
The exact observed reduced-chi-squared values and cross-run deltas may be reported as measurements.

authority.reason: LTP inspects the path and response boundary; it does not issue scientific authority.

blocked_response_claims: The reconstructed image satisfies an independently reviewed absolute scientific fit threshold.
The diagnostic refutes calibration-artifact, imaging-prior, jet-only, variability-bias, or non-Kerr alternatives.
The diagnostic authorizes promotion of the M87 reconstruction claim above S3.
claim_boundary: Tool facts about executed diagnostics are supported. Absolute-fit acceptance, alternative refutation, and evidence-level promotion remain blocked because thresholds and independent authority are absent.
required_next_action: Register and independently review observable-specific thresholds before evaluating falsification tests or changing the S3 evidence level.
